local function dA()for _,c in ipairs(Cn)do pcall(function()c:Disconnect()end)end table.clear(Cn)end

local function gH()local c=gC()return c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")end
local function gHu()local c=gC()return c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")end

local function lookAtTarget()local t=gTP(tN)if not t then R:Notify({Title="⚠️ تنبيه",Content="لم اجد لاعب بهذا الاسم!",Duration=3})return end local tc,mc=t.Character,gC()local tr,mr=tc and tc:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"),mc and mc:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")if not(tr and mr)then return end local d=(tr.Position-mr.Position).Unit mr.CFrame=CFrame.new(mr.Position,mr.Position+Vector3.new(d.X,0,d.Z))R:Notify({Title="👁️ تم التوجيه ✅",Content="تنظر لـ "..t.DisplayName,Duration=2})end
local function updNoclip()task.spawn(function()while Noclip do local c=gC()if c then for _,d in ipairs(c:GetDescendants())do if d:IsA("BasePart")then d.CanCollide=false end end end task.wait()end end)end

local function sAf()if not Af then return end task.spawn(function()while Af do pcall(function()local c,h,hu=gC(),gH(),gHu()if c and h and hu then if h.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude<0.1 and hu:GetState()~=Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated then h.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero end if hu:GetState()==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall then hu:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed)end if hu.WalkSpeed>0 and hu.WalkSpeed<1 then hu.WalkSpeed=16 end if hu.JumpPower>0 and hu.JumpPower<1 then hu.JumpPower=50 end end end)task.wait(0.5)end end)end
local function sAc()if not Ac then return end task.spawn(function()while Ac do pcall(function()for _,v in pairs(workspace:GetDescendants())do if(v:IsA("BasePart")or v:IsA("MeshPart"))and v.Transparency==1 and v.Size.Magnitude>100 then v:Destroy()end end end)task.wait(2)end end)end
local function sAl()if not Al then return end task.spawn(function()while Al do pcall(function()for _,v in pairs(workspace:GetDescendants())do if v:IsA("ParticleEmitter")then v.Enabled=false task.wait(0.1)v.Enabled=true elseif v:IsA("Trail")or v:IsA("Beam")or v:IsA("Smoke")then v.Enabled=false elseif v:IsA("Explosion")then v:Destroy()elseif v:IsA("Fire")then v.Size=0 end end end)task.wait(5)end end)end
local function sUP()if not Ue then dA()return end dA()task.wait(0.4)table.insert(Cn,Rs.Heartbeat:Connect(function()pcall(function()local h=gH()if h then lSc=h.CFrame end end)end))table.insert(Cn,Rs.Heartbeat:Connect(function()if not Ue then return end pcall(function()local c,h,hu=gC(),gH(),gHu()if not(c and h and hu)then return end hu:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated,false)if hu:GetState()==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated then hu:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)end for _,p in ipairs(c:GetDescendants())do if p:IsA("BasePart")then p.CanCollide=true p.Anchored=false end end h.AssemblyAngularVelocity=Vector3.zero if h.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude>MxS then rP()end h.CustomPhysicalProperties=PhysicalProperties.new(0.01,0,0,0,0)end)end))table.insert(Cn,Rs.Heartbeat:Connect(function()if not Ue then return end pcall(function()local h=gH()if not h then return end local n=tick()if n-lC<0.15 then return end lC=n if h.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y<MxF or h.Position.Y<MY then rP()end end)end))sAf()sAc()sAl()end

local function AI_F(tc)local h=tc:FindFirstChild("Head")if h and h:IsA("BasePart")then return h.CFrame end for _,p in ipairs(tc:GetChildren())do if p:IsA("BasePart")and p.Name:lower():find("head")then return p.CFrame end end local hp,my=nil,-math.huge for _,p in ipairs(tc:GetDescendants())do if p:IsA("BasePart")and p.Position.Y>my then hp,my=p,p.Position.Y end end if hp then return hp.CFrame end local r,hu=tc:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"),tc:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")if r and hu then return r.CFrame+Vector3.new(0,hu.HipHeight+1.85,0)end if r then return r.CFrame+Vector3.new(0,2.1,0)end end

local function pCA(id)local hu=gHu()if not hu then return end sAM()local a=Instance.new("Animation")local realId=tostring(id)local ok,objs=pcall(function()return game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://"..realId)end)if ok and objs and #objs>0 then for _,v in ipairs(objs)do if v:IsA("Animation")then a=v break elseif v:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animation")then a=v:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animation")break end end else a.AnimationId="rbxassetid://"..realId end local an=hu:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")or Instance.new("Animator",hu)cT=an:LoadAnimation(a)cT.Looped=true cT:AdjustSpeed(aS)cT:Play()end

Rs.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)if aM~=nil then pcall(function()local t=gTP(tN)if t and t.Character then local tR=t.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")local mR=gH()if tR and mR then if aM=="dolphin"then mR.CFrame=mR.CFrame:Lerp(tR.CFrame*CFrame.new(0,0,1),math.clamp(dt*fS*0.3,0,1))mR.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero elseif aM=="suck"then local w=math.sin(tick()*sWS)*0.35 local tc=tR.CFrame*CFrame.new(0,0,1.2+w)mR.CFrame=mR.CFrame:Lerp(CFrame.new(tc.Position,tR.Position),math.clamp(dt*fS*0.35,0,1))mR.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero mR.AssemblyAngularVelocity=Vector3.zero end end end end)end end)

local function SF(Tp)local C=P.Character local Rp=C and C:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")local Hu=C and C:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")local TC=Tp.Character local TR=TC and TC:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")if not(Rp and Hu and TR)then return end local BV=Instance.new("BodyVelocity")BV.Velocity=Vector3.new(9e8,9e8,9e8)BV.MaxForce=Vector3.new(math.huge,math.huge,math.huge)BV.Parent=Rp local st=time()local a=0 while(time()-st)<FTm and FA do a=a+120 Rp.CFrame=TR.CFrame*CFrame.new(0,1.5,0)*CFrame.Angles(math.rad(a),0,0)Rp.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.new(9e7,9e7,9e7)task.wait()Rp.CFrame=TR.CFrame*CFrame.new(0,-1.5,0)task.wait()Rp.CFrame=TR.CFrame*CFrame.new(2,1,-2)task.wait()Rp.CFrame=TR.CFrame*CFrame.new(-2,-1,2)task.wait()end BV:Destroy()end
